analyst.summary: Lodha Developers had a strong FY26 -- record pre-sales, rising profits, resolution of its long-running family brand dispute, and a comfortably low debt level -- and has laid out an ambitious growth plan through FY31 that includes a large new data-centre business. Execution has genuinely been good. But the stock's price already reflects most of that good news: it trades at a rich valuation for a real-estate developer, a business still concentrated in the expensive Mumbai market, where cash collections have been growing slower than headline sales. We rate it a Hold -- a quality business, but not offering value at current levels, and without a fresh red flag serious enough to call for an exit either.
